title: Boolean-selected stage value
statement: Let a counting-algorithm state have stage $i$ and stage-plus-one $i1$, and let $b$ be Boolean. The register vector entry at the index selected by $b$ is $i$ if $b$ is true and $i1$ if $b$ is false.
replaced:
Let a state have natural-number registers $i$ and $i_1$, and let $b$ be a Boolean value.
The state vector's entry at the register selected by $b$ is $i$ when $b$ is true and
$i_1$ when $b$ is false.
